title: Ineseño language
extract: Ineseño is an extinct and revitalizing Chumashan language spoken in southern California. It was closely related to, and may have been a dialect of, Barbareño. Ineseño is currently undergoing processes of language revitalization. An Ineseño dictionary was published in 2007.
